action: Customers who reuse a Hugendubel password elsewhere should change it, enable two-factor authentication, check account statements and be wary of phishing emails posing as Hugendubel (netzwelt's advice).
date_note: netzwelt says the attack happened in the night to 19 November; its article is dated 21 November.
exec: A bookseller's online shop and its Tolino cloud were offline after a reported cyberattack; netzwelt relays that it may take several days to return.
plain: German bookseller Hugendubel's online shop and Tolino Cloud were unreachable. netzwelt reports a cyberattack; Hugendubel says no sensitive customer data appears to have been taken so far.
summary: According to netzwelt, the Hugendubel online shop was hit by a cyberattack in the night to 19 November; the shop's notice cites a technical fault. Customer service and the Tolino Cloud were also offline. netzwelt relays an Instagram post in which Hugendubel says no sensitive customer data appears to have been taken so far and the shop may take several days to return.
title: Hugendubel online shop and Tolino Cloud offline after reported cyberattack

validation.note: Single publisher (netzwelt, 21 Nov). Hugendubel's Instagram statement is relayed by netzwelt and was not read directly; no second publisher read.

review.note: Compared title, date (night to 19 Nov), shop notice, Tolino Cloud and customer service offline, no sensitive data taken so far, several days, advice against the netzwelt article of 21 Nov; single_source, developing, severity 2 fit
